title: Borrowed Manifest
description: A curious customer tries to peek at another customer's customs paperwork by guessing at a shipment id that isn't theirs. Confirm the documents endpoints enforce the exact same ownership boundary as the shipment record itself.
successCondition: Customer A books a shipment. Customer B (a distinct account) calls GET /api/booking/:id/documents and POST /api/booking/:id/documents against Customer A's shipment id — both return 403 with error.code FORBIDDEN, and no document is created by the attempted upload (confirmed by Customer A subsequently listing 0 documents).
hints: Both the read and write document routes call the same findOwnedShipment ownership check used by GET /api/booking/:id — test both, not just one.

A dispatcher or admin account, by contrast, should succeed at both calls against Customer A's shipment — that's a useful contrast case if you want to confirm the boundary is role-specific, not blanket.
